answer: Make each account prove work before it earns: identity is priced by a verifiable history of completed tasks on a public ledger, like a reef growing layer by layer or a vine that must climb over time. New accounts earn pennies; reputation accrues only through audited, scarce compute. An attacker mass-registering gets timber-thin accounts worth nothing, so registration costs exceed any payout, and sybil votes carry the weight of their earned history, not their number.
